    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + row_lines + [h]

    bands = [(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(rb) - 1)]
    cells = [(cb[i] + 1, cb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cb) - 1)]

    # Reflect each patterned region vertically across each horizontal divider,
    # copying any missing reflected cells into the neighboring region.
    for k in range(1, len(bands) - 1):
        top, end = bands[k]
        low, low_end = bands[k + 1]
        height = min(end - top, low_end - low)
        for left, right in cells:
            upper = [(r - top, c - left, grid[r][c])
                     for r in range(top, top + height)
                     for c in range(left, right) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)]
            lower = [(r - low, c - left, grid[r][c])
                     for r in range(low, low + height)
                     for c in range(left, right) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)]

            for dr, dc, color in lower:

                if out[rr][cc] == 0:

    return out

        below_end = rb[i + 1]
        above_height = divider - above_start

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider = 8

    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == divider for v in grid[r])]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]

    # Reflect the colored pattern in every compartment across each horizontal
    # divider, filling only the corresponding empty cells on the other side.
    for sep in row_lines:
        above = sep - 1
        below = sep + 1
        while above >= 0 and grid[above][0] != divider and below < h and grid[below][0] != divider:
            # Work within each column compartment; the divider columns stay untouched.
            for c in range(w):
                if c in col_lines:
                    continue
                a, b = grid[above][c], grid[below][c]
                if a not in (0, divider) and b == 0:
                    out[below][c] = a
                if b not in (0, divider) and a == 0:
                    out[above][c] = b
            above -= 1
            below += 1

    return out
